trial_court: Court of Civil Judge-06, (Central), Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi - CS SCJ No. : 2277/18
case_name: Icici Bank Ltd vs Abhishek Kumar Singh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: ICICI Bank Limited, Through its Authorized Representative Sh. Mohit Grover
parties.respondent_defendant: Abhishek Kumar Singh, S/o Sh. Kailas Prasad Singh

facts_of_case: ICICI Bank Ltd filed a suit for recovery of Rs. 56,152/- with interest @ 23% P.A. against Abhishek Kumar Singh who had defaulted in repayment of loan amount.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the defendant to prove that the notice was not received.
legal_principles.held: When after several requests and reminders to the defendant for payment of loan amount, the plaintiff bank was compelled to serve notice dated 15.03.2018 to the defendant recalling/foreclosing the entire loan agreement but despite receipt of the notice, the defendant neither cared to reply to the said notice nor made any effort to repay the outstanding amount.

legal_principles.principle: A defendant's failure to respond to a notice can be considered as deemed service.
legal_principles.held: The defendant was then served through publication and hence, the defendant was deemed to be served on 31.08.2022 and vide order dated 25.02.2023 as no one appeared for the defendant accordingly, right to file Written Statement was closed by the Court order and defendant was proceeded Ex-parte.

outcome.final_order: The final court order directed the defendant to pay the outstanding amount along with interest.

keywords: RUPEES FIFTY SIX THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED FIFTY TWO
